name: Camaquã (Brazil)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a mural crown between wheat and rice, over a scroll reading 1815 CAMAQUÃ 1864 LIBERDADE E TRABALHO.
history: Camaquã is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the coat of arms is prescribed by Municipal Law No. 167 of 30 August 1960.
